note: Both sets are factually clean against Table 5.5-5 — every quoted value, channel binding and condition (e.g. "35 mas (at 0.67 µm)", "IWA (2.4 λ/D)") checks out, and each has the same mild ambiguity where "Detector" and "Array width" are claimed per channel without separating the Cameras and Spectrometers rows. The sets share 12 claims and each adds 13 unique ones, but A's additions cover the core science specs: all five wavelength bands, all three telescope resolutions (with wavelength conditions) and all three spectrometer resolutions, whereas B's additions are mostly hardware rows (detectors, spectrometer types, DM pitch) plus two IWA values. B therefore omits telescope resolution entirely and four of the five wavelength bands, a heavier coverage gap than A's omission of the IWA row, so A is the more complete and useful extraction.
